diem.mo_ta: The thirteen Yang Gong taboo days of the year. Vietnamese folk almanacs list the 7th month as the 8th and 29th days and also apply leap months; the Xie Ji book lists the 7th month as the 1st and 29th and says nothing about leap months.

lua_chon.mo_ta: In the 7th month avoid the 8th and 29th; a leap month is treated like the regular month.
In the 7th month avoid the 1st and 29th; leap months are not counted. The book also says these are only days of the Room mansion counted from New Year, not something to fear.
